explication: This repository packages AI-assisted code-review prompts for Linux kernel, systemd, iproute, nfs-utils, and pahole. The main workflow is an engineer invoking a project’s review, debug, or verify command; the project skill supplies context and subsystem guides provide domain-specific knowledge. Kernel also includes substantial review utilities for categorizing patch changes, processing Claude output, and running parallel Claude commands. Relationships reflect the README and sampled script behavior; unsampled prompt files are represented by their existing directories.
